description.value: An American multinational financial technology company headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, that processes debit and credit card transactions, loyalty programs and loans for financial institutions.

A publicly traded American financial technology company that processes card transactions, bill payments, transfers, check deposits and ATM transactions for banks and other financial institutions, and makes payment cards and point-of-sale terminals.
Calls itself 'the largest fintech at the intersection of banking and commerce', powering growth and innovation for financial institutions and businesses worldwide.
Describes itself as 'the largest fintech at the intersection of banking and commerce', offering technology for financial institutions and businesses worldwide.
A global payments and financial technology company providing payments and financial services technology to clients including merchants, banks, credit unions and other financial institutions.

product_description.value: Debit and credit card transaction processing, loyalty programs, loans and related banking services for financial institutions.
Card, bill payment, transfer, check deposit and ATM processing for banks; payment cards and point-of-sale terminals. Products include Clover, Carat, CardHub and Pinch Payments.

Commerce Hub (payment and embedded finance for enterprises and platforms); agentOS, an operating system for financial services agents; digital banking and platforms for banks and credit unions; small business systems for merchants; bill pay for the public sector; and integrated payments for software providers and ISVs.

Commerce Hub (payment orchestration across 190+ countries); digital banking and platforms; agentOS; Finxact, a SaaS banking platform; bill pay and public sector payments; and software provider payments.

Account processing and digital banking, card issuer processing and network services, payments, e-commerce, merchant acquiring and processing, and the Clover point-of-sale and business management platform. A third-party profile adds fraud and risk tools and bill pay.

business_model_description.value: Processing made up 81% of revenue and products 19% (2024).
Largely recurring: processing and services were 80% of 2025 revenue, primarily account- and transaction-based fees under multi-year contracts with high renewal rates.

customer_description.value: Financial institutions, for whom it processes card transactions and related banking services.
Mainly financial institutions such as banks, credit unions and savings and loans, plus broker-dealers, mortgage, insurance and leasing firms, and retailers.

Enterprises and large merchants (which it says include 70% of the world's leading brands), small businesses, banks, credit unions and large financial institutions, fintechs, public sector clients (government, education, utilities), and software providers and ISVs.
Banks, credit unions and large financial institutions; enterprises and large merchants; fintechs; small businesses and merchants; software providers and ISVs; public sector clients.
Merchants, banks, credit unions, other financial institutions, and corporate and public sector clients.

revenue.value: $21.2 billion total revenue (2025, per the FY2025 10-K)
